notes.title: Magical Fire Book
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32879679/d1ad2c730bad5bfa0f85a968270b0f9e72762af3.png[/img]

[h1]Magical Fire Book[/h1] 

Added a fire book to make defense spells.

[h1]How to use?[/h1]

The book shines at certain intervals. When the book shines you can make the defense spell.

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
    [*]You will be immortal for 20 seconds
    [*]Reuse takes about 30 seconds.
    [*]You can not get points from spirits killed by the book.
[/list] 
[h1]Notes[/h1]

This feature is still in its development phase. Please report the bugs.

notes.title: 37 New Achievements
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32879679/acc4d7c6fd8d5b23911c7501c65dbc5866511734.png[/img]

[h1]Wizard Street Achievements[/h1] 

37 new cool achievements have been added for use in Profiles.

[h1]Content[/h1] 
[list]
    [*]26 letter achievements
    [*]10 number achievements
    [*]1 blank achievement
[/list] 
[h1]How do I unlock achievements?[/h1] 
[list]
    [*]every time you kill 10 dark souls a achievement opens.
    [*]all achievement are opens when 370 dark souls are killed in total.
[/list] 
You can open up all your achievements in very short time and use them in your profile.
